reasons.plausibility: This hypothesis aligns well with well‐established understanding that mechanical twinning in low SFE FCC alloys can enhance both strength and ductility under dynamic loading.
reasons.testability: A clear comparative experiment is proposed, where twin-promoting versus twin-suppressing conditions are directly compared via microstructural and mechanical measurements, providing a straightforward test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a focused, mechanistic explanation and a direct test protocol that would be valuable to researchers studying dynamic strengthening mechanisms in FCC HEAs.
